description: This file defines a final utility class 'TaskWorker' which provides static methods for processing and retrieving information about order task entities within the OFBiz framework. The class includes methods to get customer names, pretty status labels, and role descriptions associated with order tasks.

classes.name: TaskWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling order task information such as customer names, statuses, and role descriptions within the OFBiz order processing context.

methods.name: getCustomerName
methods.description: Constructs and returns the full name of the customer from the order task's customer last and first names, formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.

methods.name: getPrettyStatus
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly status label based on the current status ID of the order task, defaulting to '?' if the status is unknown.

methods.name: getRoleDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the role type associated with the order task by querying the RoleType entity. Handles exceptions gracefully.
